gaps.summary: Track D landed (2026-09-14): players die, Hospital Selection offers Refugee Base Medic (graveyard 20000001) and the respawn uses its marker position, calibrated to 1.1 m against A4-39. Still absent: trauma above level 5, equipment wear, ally revival, death persistence across logout, and the "Not yourself!" message.
evidence: footage A4-35..A4-39 (death and hospital inside the boot camp)
gaps.closes_with: trauma, wear, ally revival and persistence evidence (hospital-catalog.json gaps)

gaps.summary: Kill experience, credits and the solo kill streak now follow the client constants and a fit to every clean final-week kill (71 XP / 10 credits for a level-2 Initiate, +100% streak with 1 prestige on the third kill). Still absent: level-difference, squad, partial-credit and crit-kill modifiers, and original loot tables.
gaps.closes_with: evidence for the remaining modifiers (kill-rewards.json gaps)

non_content_settings.note: Operational rollout and rollback gate for the rebuilt boot camp. It is not gameplay and not a reconstructed original value: it only decides which new characters start in context 1985 (build plan section 1.2 entry gate, invariant I8, OD-1). When it does not admit a character, creation keeps the existing context 1220 start.
